Read Level 1 in order, answer the questions, and try Practice and Play. Each file has its own guide version and does not check for updates. In MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, major may require migration, minor adds compatible features, and patch makes compatible corrections. Before switching files, select My Progress, then Save progress file in the old version. Select Restore progress file in the new version and confirm your chapter count before removing the old file. Browser storage may vary by file location.

items: Check the exact item and its identifier before comparing versions.
Use an explicitly accepted reference rather than an unapproved draft.
A request, a decision and a completed installation are different states.
When a version changes, update every affected technical record.
Report unknown states as unknown, not as confirmed.
Draw conclusions only from evidence that actually answers the question.

text: Always identify the item, its accepted description, the decision role, affected interfaces and proof of completed work.

A configuration is the identified set of product parts, software and technical information that belongs to a specified version. Managing it means agreeing on reference descriptions, recording authorized decisions, and checking what was actually built or installed. Identification, change review, status tracking and audits are linked activities: each provides evidence the next relies on.

items: State the product boundary and assign control responsibilities

Review a proposed difference before authorized work proceeds
Record decisions separately from real-world completion
